result.title: Understanding Practical Optimization in Machine Learning
result.summary: Modern machine learning relies on practical optimization methods that often differ from the algorithms studied in classical analyses: they train submodels, clip or normalize gradients, use layer-wise non-Euclidean directions, or approximate costly inner computations. This thesis analyzes the objective, assumptions, update, and computation defined by these procedures, rather than those of simplified proxies. For submodel training, we show that Independent Subnetwork Training can converge to a shifted fixed point because sketching before differentiation biases the update for the original objective. Model-Agnostic Sparsified Training instead incorporates the sketch distribution into its objective, which makes sketched gradients unbiased and admits convergence guarantees. For private optimization, we show that adaptive quantile clipping retains bias at any fixed quantile, while suitable quantile schedules recover near-optimal nonconvex rates under heavy-tailed noise. We then combine smoothed normalization with error compensation and obtain distributed private convergence guarantees under standard assumptions, without assuming bounded gradients. For optimizers based on linear minimization oracles, we develop and validate a layer-wise generalized smoothness model and build on it the Gluon framework for Muon- and Scion-style methods. We also show that the approximate orthogonalization in Muon matters: less precise orthogonalization calls for smaller stepsizes, so its precision should be tuned together with the learning rate. Overall, practical methods are better understood when theory retains the features that determine their optimization behavior.

AI.brief_summary: 博士论文针对子网络训练、隐私优化中的自适应分位裁剪、以及基于线性最小化 oracle 的优化器，分析实际方法的优化目标、假设、更新与计算，并给出相应收敛性结论（如需把 Muon 近似正交化的精度与步长联合调节）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其逐层广义光滑性建模与「正交化精度影响可用步长」的结论，可能为训练深层或循环式 latent reasoning VLM 的优化稳定性与超参数选择提供线索，但论文不含视觉或多模态内容，迁移价值需核查。
